title: Correct field rename in both request and response is a solid minimal fix
description: The fix updates both the 'properties' request array and the response .get() call atomically in the same commit. This is correct: if only one side were updated, the field would either not be returned by the server or not be read from the response. A contributor might suggest splitting this into two commits or 'fixing' it by adding both names with a fallback; that would be wrong. The correct approach — one atomic rename of both sides — is what was done.
